cases.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 (patient iPSC-derived neurons under mitochondrial stress)
cases.mechanism_detail: The XDP-causing SVA retrotransposon insertion in TAF1 is taken as the disease variant; this study profiles transcriptomes of XDP patient-derived cortical neurons, showing broad pathway downregulation and increased DNA damage after mitochondrial toxin exposure, without directly testing how the SVA alters TAF1.
cases.quote: The underlying genetic mechanism involves a shared common haplotype identified in all patients, including the disease-causing variant, the SINE-VNTR-Alu (SVA) retrotransposon, within the TAF1 gene.
